title: Derivation of the resistive matter-TT-graviton coupling from a local retained sector (V1-V11, repaired v3)
protocol: Start from the established local retained sector and the minimal universal graviton stress coupling, derive the vertex matrix elements, build the on-shell golden-rule DENSITY, and measure the IR scaling of |M|^2, J, K_R on two instrument classes (windowed box sum + tolerance-free exact-root continuum quadrature). Counterfactual suite verifies the instrument finds the tracelessness cancellation rather than inheriting it. Verdict: DERIVED / DISDERIVED / UNDERDETERMINED.

checks.name: V1_vertex_constructed_with_nonzero_resistive_weights
checks.summary: Minimal stress-energy vertex built from the retained chain: 20508/29876 (mode,pol) weights nonzero. No spectral weight fitted; weights come entirely from on-shell matrix elements of the local stress (full bracket).

checks.name: V1b_golden_rule_density_converges_channel_open
checks.summary: Golden-rule density vs domega: ['2.165e+00', '2.135e+00', '2.105e+00', '2.352e+00'] -- halving ratios ['0.99', '0.99', '1.12'] (converging to a finite limit => channel OPEN). Emptiness controls: NORMAL same-sign fraction (omega < 2.4, below umklapp) 3.82e-02 -> 0.00e+00 on domega/4 (vanishing); gapped chain below 2*Omega: density 0.0e+00 IDENTICALLY ZERO (what true kinematic emptiness looks like).

checks.name: V1c_exact_interior_onshell_roots_exist_at_all_oblique_angles
checks.summary: Brent root-finding on w(a)+w(b)=omega, a-b=mu*omega (no tolerance anywhere): 16/16 configs across omega in [0.3,1.5], mu in [0,0.9] have exact interior on-shell roots at machine-precision residual. The counter-propagating channel is OPEN at every oblique angle; the v2b inequality w+w' < |q+q'| holds only for same-sign pairs.

checks.name: V2_onshell_M2_density_matches_pre_registered_omega6
checks.summary: On-shell |M|^2 density per mode ~ omega^6.87 vs PRE-REGISTERED omega^6 (tol 1.0; box k-shell lumpiness limits this instrument -- the clean check is V3b).

checks.name: V3_box_J_matches_pre_registered_omega7
checks.summary: Box J(omega) ~ omega^7.02 vs PRE-REGISTERED omega^7 (tol 1.0, box-lumpiness-limited; clean check is V3b).

checks.name: V3b_continuum_J_slope_matches_pre_registered_omega7
checks.summary: Continuum (tolerance-free) J ~ omega^7.008 on [0.05, 0.35] vs PRE-REGISTERED omega^7 (tol 0.15). Two instrument classes, one object.

checks.name: V3b_continuum_coefficient_matches_analytic_asymptote
checks.summary: J_cont/J_asymptote = 1.0005 at omega=0.06 (asymptote B = -omega^3 sqrt(1-mu^2)(1+mu^2)/192): coefficient-level agreement, not slope-only (sealed G6).

checks.name: V4_analytic_continuum_kernel_has_watson_t^-8_tail
checks.summary: Exact continuum kernel for the DERIVED J ~ omega^7 fits t^-7.981 (Watson prediction -8, coefficient 5040 != 0): branch-cut power-law memory class -- NOT the single exponential of the original GRUT ansatz, and NOT a finite pole sum.

checks.name: V4_discrete_box_kernel_matches_continuum_in_accessible_window
checks.summary: Discrete-box kernel shape vs exact continuum kernel: corr 1.0000 on t <= 5.09; corr 0.9999 on t <= 10.19 at 2L (window grows with L as the continuum limit requires). Raw discrete envelope t^-0.41 is the box floor, banked as instrumentation.

checks.name: V5_response_is_passive
checks.summary: chi''(omega) = pi J(omega) >= 0 across the derived band (min 4.197e-08): strictly dissipative, as the constitutive sector requires.

checks.name: V6_V7_fdt_holds_onshell_from_per_mode_occupations
checks.summary: N_T/J_T vs coth(omega/2T) from PER-MODE occupations: max relative deviation 3.06e-02 on shell (finite-domega smearing only). Genuine: the relation depends on energy conservation, not algebra.

checks.name: V6_V7_negative_control_detuned_shell_violates_fdt
checks.summary: Detuned shell (+0.4): median relative deviation 0.33 >> on-shell 3.1e-02 -- the FDT check FAILS when energy conservation is broken, proving it is a contentful test, not an identity.

checks.name: V8_vertex_respects_transversality_selection_rule
checks.summary: Mean weight along-chain 4.812e-07 vs perpendicular 3.307e-05 (ratio 1.5e-02): the transversality selection rule emerges unimposed from the minimal coupling.

checks.name: V9_gapped_chain_j_zero_below_two_phonon_threshold
checks.summary: Gapped chain (Omega=1): J identically ZERO below 2*Omega (max bin 0.0e+00) -- TRUE kinematic emptiness: identical zero at finite tolerance, not linear-in-domega vanishing. The two sectors' memory classes differ structurally (sector-set, as banked).

checks.name: V9_threshold_step_finite_and_flat
checks.summary: Just above 2*Omega, J is a finite step: bins ['1.44e+01', '1.13e+01', '1.23e+01', '1.82e+01', '1.61e+01']..., max/min 1.95 < 6 (angle-integrated van Hove is a step, not a -1/2 power law -- corrected pre-registration).

checks.name: V10_tidal_vertex_shifts_J_exponent_exactly_plus_two
checks.summary: Tidal vertex: J ~ omega^9.05 vs omega^7.02 minimal -- shift +2.03 vs PRE-REGISTERED +2 (pointwise identity, max dev 5.9e-16). Vertex class moves the exponent on the on-shell object.

checks.name: V11_kinetic_only_gives_omega3
checks.summary: Kinetic-only vertex: J ~ omega^3.003 vs PRE-REGISTERED omega^3 -- no cancellation, four powers above the full bracket.

checks.name: V11_potential_only_gives_omega3
checks.summary: Potential-only vertex (the v2b mutilation): J ~ omega^3.006 vs PRE-REGISTERED omega^3 -- also uncancelled; neither term alone is the physics.

checks.name: V11_linear_dispersion_full_bracket_vanishes
checks.summary: Linear dispersion (w=|q|), full bracket: max |J| = 1.71e-34 vs full-vertex J(0.2) = 3.30e-09 -- exact tracelessness zero at machine precision. The omega^7 is lattice-curvature-generated, not soft-theorem-generated.

checks.name: V11_lattice_sine_vertex_vanishes_identically
checks.summary: Lattice-sine potential vertex: max |J| = 3.01e-34 -- the cancellation becomes exact at ALL orders (sealed ledger side-prediction), confirming the omega^7 rests on the bare-momentum discretization of the stress vertex.

V1.vertex: golden-rule density: W = SUM_shell |(kappa/2) e_xx B(q,q')/sqrt(N)|^2 / (2 w_k 2 domega), B = (1/2)[sqrt(w w') + q q'/sqrt(w w')] (FULL stress bracket, kinetic restored)

V1b.interpretation: the golden-rule DENSITY converges to a finite limit as domega -> 0: the acoustic two-phonon channel is OPEN (counter-propagating pairs resonate at every oblique angle). True emptiness looks like the controls: same-sign fraction tiny and collapsing; gapped-below-threshold density identically zero. The v2b 'Cherenkov no-go' verdict is retired per U3_COUPLING_ADJUDICATION_03.

V2.prediction_basis: sealed ledger: B ~ omega^3 after the kinetic/potential tracelessness cancellation; |M|^2 density per mode ~ omega^6

V3.prediction_basis: sealed ledger mapped to this convention: |M|^2 ~ omega^6, 1/(2 omega), DOS omega^2 -> J ~ omega^7

V4.prediction_basis: J ~ omega^7 (V3/V3b, sealed ledger) -> Watson tail t^-8, coefficient Gamma(8) = 5040 (nonvanishing). REPAIRS v2b, which computed the tail for the REFUTED omega^3 pre-registration.
V4.box_limitation: box has no modes below 2 pi/L ~ 0.196; the raw discrete tail exponent is NOT the asymptote -- benchmarked against the exact closed form instead

V6_V7.construction: J_T ~ SUM |M|^2 [(1+n_q)(1+n_q') - n_q n_q'], N_T ~ SUM |M|^2 [(1+n_q)(1+n_q') + n_q n_q'], per-mode n = 1/(e^{w/T}-1); FDT: N_T/J_T = coth(omega/2T) holds ONLY on the energy shell
V6_V7.note: REPAIRS the v2/v2b tautology (n_B(omega) plugged into coth's own identity): here the two sides depend on the PAIR frequencies separately and agree only because the shell enforces w_q + w_q' = omega -- the detuned control proves the check can fail.

V8.selection_rule: e_xx = 0 for k-hat parallel to the chain (transversality) -> leading-order decoupling; near-aligned bins admit small e_xx, so suppressed not strictly zero

V9.pre_registered: J identically 0 below 2*Omega at every domega (true emptiness); finite STEP just above (angle-integrated van Hove) -- corrects v2b's -1/2 pre-registration, which applied to fixed k_par, not to J(omega)

V11.note: each single stress term alone gives omega^3; the full bracket gives omega^7: the tracelessness cancellation is worth omega^4 and the instrument FINDS it (kinetic-only and potential-only controls at identical settings). Linear dispersion and lattice-sine vertex: exact zeros.

imports.kappa: dimensionful graviton coupling (1/M_Pl): IMPORT. Only exponents are tested; kappa=1 throughout.
imports.matter_structure: the retained sector's dispersion is a structural input; the acoustic chain is scale-free at low frequency (omega_q = 2|sin(q/2)|), the optical chain carries an imported gap Omega=1.
imports.minimal_stress_coupling: L_int = -(kappa/2) h T is the minimal covariant local matter-graviton coupling of its dimension; using it is a structural postulate banked in the import ledger.

verdict_detail: DERIVED WITHIN THE MINIMAL-STRESS CLASS (repaired v3 instrument; verdict assembled from this run's measurements). The acoustic two-phonon graviton channel is OPEN (V1b density converges, ratios 0.99/0.99/1.12; V1c 16/16 exact interior roots at machine precision) -- the v2b 'Cherenkov no-go' is retired (its inequality applied only to same-sign pairs; its control lacked the golden-rule 1/(2 domega)). With the FULL stress bracket restored (kinetic + potential), the measured spectral density is: box J ~ omega^7.02 (prereg 7, lumpiness-limited), continuum J ~ omega^7.008 (prereg 7 +/- 0.15), coefficient ratio 1.000 vs the analytic asymptote (prereg <= 3%): the sealed blinded prediction of the adjudicator ledger (d2da3a5) is CONFIRMED at exponent AND coefficient level on the tolerance-free instrument. Kernel: Watson tail t^-7.98 (prereg -8) -- branch-cut memory class. Mechanism identified, not assumed: kinetic-only omega^3.00 and potential-only omega^3.01 (both prereg 3), full bracket omega^7 -- the tracelessness cancellation is worth omega^4 and the counterfactual suite finds it; linear-dispersion and lattice-sine zeros exact. FDT now genuine (per-mode occupations; on-shell dev 3.1e-02; detuned control VIOLATES at 0.33). Gapped sector: true emptiness below 2*Omega (identical zero) + threshold step -- sector structure sets the memory class. Imports ledgered: kappa, retained-sector structure, minimal-stress postulate. The class-4 gate remains governed by the theorem gate: the exponent is DERIVED within the minimal-stress class with imports ledgered; suppliedness sits in the class choices, as the RRP conservation regularity predicts.
consequences: The resistive matter-graviton coupling is DERIVED within the minimal-stress class for acoustic matter: J ~ omega^7 (this convention), branch-cut kernel t^-8 -- confirming the sealed adjudicator pre-registration at exponent and coefficient level; dual pre-registration protocol executed (builder prereg refuted by the run in v2; adjudicator prereg confirmed in v3).

Gravitational dissipation of traceless subsonic acoustic matter is suppressed far beyond the quadrupole folklore (omega^7 here, not omega^5): matter-sector tracelessness + lattice parity, with the same-sign channel closed by cone kinematics. Sector structure (gapped vs acoustic) changes the class outright.
The v2b 'Cherenkov no-go' is retired: the emptiness signature is identical zero (gapped below threshold), not linear-in-domega vanishing of an unnormalized windowed sum.
claims.json untouched; no promotion beyond derived-within-class.
